001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.list.array.TIntArrayList;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
013import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
014
015/**
016 * <p>
017 * Join a unary relation with a binary relation. The {@code take} variable is
018 * the unary relation and the {@code children} variables are the binary
019 * relation. The {@code to} variable is the result of the join.
020 * </p>
021 * <p>
022 * Here is how the binary relation is encoded. Consider the relation:
023 * {@code (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 3), (2, 1)}. This is encoded as 3 different
024 * {@code children} variables: {@code child0={1, 2}, child1={3}, child2={1}}.
025 * </p>
026 *
027 * @author jimmy
028 */
029public class PropJoinRelation extends Propagator<SetVar> {
030
031    private final SetVar take;
032    private final ISetDeltaMonitor takeD;
033    private final SetVar[] children;
034    private final ISetDeltaMonitor[] childrenD;
035    private final SetVar to;
036    private final ISetDeltaMonitor toD;
037
038    public PropJoinRelation(SetVar take, SetVar[] children, SetVar to) {
039        super(buildArray(take, to, children), PropagatorPriority.QUADRATIC, true);
040        this.take = take;
041        this.takeD = take.monitorDelta(this);
042        this.children = children;
043        this.childrenD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(children, this);
044        this.to = to;
045        this.toD = to.monitorDelta(this);
046    }
047
048    private static SetVar[] buildArray(SetVar take, SetVar to, SetVar[] children) {
049        SetVar[] array = new SetVar[children.length + 2];
050        array[0] = take;
051        array[1] = to;
052        System.arraycopy(children, 0, array, 2, children.length);
053        return array;
054    }
055
056    private boolean isTakeVar(int idx) {
057        return idx == 0;
058    }
059
060    private boolean isToVar(int idx) {
061        return idx == 1;
062    }
063
064    private boolean isChildVar(int idx) {
065        return idx >= 2;
066    }
067
068    private int getChildVarIndex(int idx) {
069        assert isChildVar(idx);
070        return idx - 2;
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
075        return SetEventType.all();
076    }
077
078    private void findMate(int toEnv) throws ContradictionException {
079        boolean inKer = to.getLB().contains(toEnv);
080        int mate = -1;
081        ISetIterator iter = take.getUB().iterator();
082        while (iter.hasNext()) {
083            int j = iter.nextInt();
084            if (children[j].getUB().contains(toEnv)) {
085                // Found a second mate.
086                if (mate != -1 || !inKer) {
087                    mate = -2;
088                    break;
089                }
090                mate = j;
091            }
092        }
093        if (mate == -1) {
094            // No mates.
095            to.remove(toEnv, this);
096        } else if (mate != -2 && inKer) {
097            // One mate.
098            take.force(mate, this);
099            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(children[mate], to, this);
100            PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(children[mate], to, this);
101            children[mate].force(toEnv, this);
102        }
103    }
104
105    @Override
106    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
107        // Prune take
108        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
109        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
110            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
111            if (i < 0 || i >= children.length || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(children[i], to)) {
112                take.remove(i, this);
113            }
114        }
115
116        // Pick to and prune child
117        ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
118        while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
119            int i = takeKer.nextInt();
120            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(children[i], to, this);
121            PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(children[i], to, this);
122        }
123
124        // Pick take, pick child, pick take, prune to
125        ISetIterator toEnv = to.getUB().iterator();
126        while (toEnv.hasNext()) {
127            int i = toEnv.nextInt();
128            findMate(i);
129        }
130        takeD.startMonitoring();
131        PropUtil.startMonitoring(childrenD);
132        toD.startMonitoring();
133    }
134
135    @Override
136    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
137        if (isTakeVar(idxVarInProp)) {
138            takeD.forEach(this::pruneToOnTakeEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
139            takeD.forEach(this::pickToAndPruneChildOnTakeKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
140        } else if (isToVar(idxVarInProp)) {
141            toD.forEach(this::pruneChildOnToEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
142            toD.forEach(this::pickTakeOnToKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
143            if (SetEventType.isEnvRemoval(mask)) {
144                TIntArrayList removed = null;
145                ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
146                while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
147                    int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
148                    if (!PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(children[i], to)) {
149                        take.remove(i, this);
150                        // Cannot call findMate here because we inside iterating take env.
151                        // Queue up the even to do later.
152                        if (removed == null) {
153                            removed = new TIntArrayList(1);
154                        }
155                        removed.add(i);
156                    }
157                }
158                if (removed != null) {
159                    TIntIterator it = removed.iterator();
160                    while (it.hasNext()) {
161                        SetVar child = children[it.next()];
162                        ISetIterator childEnv = child.getUB().iterator();
163                        while (childEnv.hasNext()) {
164                            int i = childEnv.nextInt();
165                            if (to.getUB().contains(i)) {
166                                findMate(i);
167                            }
168                        }
169                    }
170                }
171            }
172        } else {
173            assert isChildVar(idxVarInProp);
174            final int id = getChildVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
175            final ISetDeltaMonitor childD = childrenD[id];
176            // Note that we MUST prune even if id is not in env(take) to ensure
177            // idempotence. Otherwise if id is removed from take and val removed
178            // from child at the same time is no longer supported, we need to
179            // remove val from to as well.
180            childD.forEach(this::pruneToOnChildEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
181            if (take.getLB().contains(id)) {
182                childD.forEach(this::pickToOnChildKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
183            } else if (take.getUB().contains(id)) {
184                childD.forEach(childKer -> {
185                    if (!to.getUB().contains(childKer)) {
186                        take.remove(id, this);
187                        ISetIterator childEnv = children[id].getUB().iterator();
188                        while (childEnv.hasNext()) {
189                            int i = childEnv.nextInt();
190                            if (to.getUB().contains(i)) {
191                                findMate(i);
192                            }
193                        }
194                    }
195                }, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
196            }
197        }
198    }
199
200    private void pruneToOnTakeEnv(int takeEnv) throws ContradictionException {
201        assert !take.getUB().contains(takeEnv);
202        ISetIterator iter = children[takeEnv].getUB().iterator();
203        while (iter.hasNext()) {
204            int i = iter.nextInt();
205            if (to.getUB().contains(i)) {
206                findMate(i);
207            }
208        }
209    }
210
211    private void pickToAndPruneChildOnTakeKer(int takeKer) throws ContradictionException {
212        assert take.getLB().contains(takeKer);
213
214        SetVar child = children[takeKer];
215        PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(child, to, this);
216        PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(child, to, this);
217    }
218
219    private void pruneToOnChildEnv(int childEnv) throws ContradictionException {
220        // Note the the child may no longer be in take, but still need to find mate.
221        // For example:
222        //     take = {0,1,2}, child0 = {0}, child1 = {1}, child2 = {2}, to = {0,1,2}
223        //   remove 2 from take and 2 from child2
224        //     take = {0,1}, child0 = {0}, child1 = {1}, child2 = {}, to = {0,1,2}
225        // Need to find mate for 2 on child2 or else to will keep 2, and break
226        // idempotency.
227        if (to.getUB().contains(childEnv)) {
228            findMate(childEnv);
229        }
230    }
231
232    private void pickToOnChildKer(int childKer) throws ContradictionException {
233        // assert id in ker(take)
234        to.force(childKer, this);
235    }
236
237    private void pruneChildOnToEnv(int toEnv) throws ContradictionException {
238        assert !to.getUB().contains(toEnv);
239
240        ISetIterator iter = take.getLB().iterator();
241        while (iter.hasNext()) {
242            children[iter.nextInt()].remove(toEnv, this);
243        }
244    }
245
246    private void pickTakeOnToKer(int toVal) throws ContradictionException {
247        assert to.getLB().contains(toVal);
248        findMate(toVal);
249    }
250
251    @Override
252    public ESat isEntailed() {
253        ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
254        while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
255            int i = takeKer.nextInt();
256            if (i < 0 || i >= children.length) {
257                return ESat.FALSE;
258            }
259            ISetIterator childKer = children[i].getLB().iterator();
260            while (childKer.hasNext()) {
261                int j = childKer.nextInt();
262                if (!to.getUB().contains(j)) {
263                    return ESat.FALSE;
264                }
265            }
266        }
267        boolean completelyInstantiated = take.isInstantiated() && to.isInstantiated();
268        int count = 0;
269        SetVar[] taken = new SetVar[take.getUB().size()];
270        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
271        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
272            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
273            if (i >= 0 && i < children.length) {
274                SetVar child = children[i];
275                completelyInstantiated = completelyInstantiated && child.isInstantiated();
276                taken[count++] = child;
277            }
278        }
279        if (count < taken.length) {
280            taken = Arrays.copyOf(taken, count);
281        }
282        ISetIterator toKer = to.getLB().iterator();
283        while (toKer.hasNext()) {
284            int i = toKer.nextInt();
285            if (!PropUtil.envsContain(taken, i)) {
286                return ESat.FALSE;
287            }
288        }
289        return completelyInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
290    }
291
292    @Override
293    public String toString() {
294        return "joinRelation(" + take + ", " + Arrays.toString(children) + ", " + to + ")";
295    }
296}
